verses.original: כִּ֗י הִנֵּ֛ה בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵ֖מָּה וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָשׁוּב אֶת־ שְׁב֥וּת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm·māh ū·ḇā·‘êṯ ha·hî ’ă·šer ʾå̄·šūḇ ’eṯ- šə·ḇūṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Yes . . . in those days and at that time when I restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity
verses.literalPt: Pois eis que, naqueles dias e naquele tempo, em que eu fizer tornar o cativeiro de Judá e de Jerusalém,

verses.original: וְקִבַּצְתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְה֣וֹרַדְתִּ֔ים אֶל־ עֵ֖מֶק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֨י עִמָּ֜ם שָׁ֗ם עַל־ עַמִּ֨י וְנַחֲלָתִ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּזְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶת־ אַרְצִ֖י חִלֵּֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim wə·hō·w·raḏ·tîm ’el- ‘ê·meq yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ wə·niš·paṭ·tî ‘im·mām šām ‘al- ‘am·mî wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯî yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer piz·zə·rū ḇag·gō·w·yim wə·’eṯ- ’ar·ṣî ḥil·lê·qū
verses.literal: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people My inheritance Israel whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land
verses.literalPt: congregarei todas as nações e as farei descer ao vale de Josafá; ali, entrarei em juízo com elas por causa do meu povo e por causa da minha herança, Israel, que elas espalharam por entre os povos, dividindo entre si a terra.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ עַמִּ֖י יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ בַּזּוֹנָ֔ה וְהַיַּלְדָּ֛ה מָכְר֥וּ בַיַּ֖יִן וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- ‘am·mî yad·dū ḡō·w·rāl way·yit·tə·nū hay·ye·leḏ baz·zō·w·nāh wə·hay·yal·dāh mā·ḵə·rū ḇay·ya·yin way·yiš·tū
verses.literal: They cast lots for My people they bartered a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine to drink
verses.literalPt: Elas deitaram sortes sobre o meu povo; deram um menino por uma meretriz e venderam uma menina por vinho para beberem.

verses.original: וְ֠גַם מָה־ אַתֶּ֥ם לִי֙ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן וְכֹ֖ל גְּלִיל֣וֹת פְּלָ֑שֶׁת הַגְּמ֗וּל אַתֶּם֙ מְשַׁלְּמִ֣ים עָלָ֔י וְאִם־ גֹּמְלִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ עָלַ֔י קַ֣ל מְהֵרָ֔ה אָשִׁ֥יב גְּמֻלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam māh- ’at·tem lî ṣōr wə·ṣî·ḏō·wn wə·ḵōl gə·lî·lō·wṯ pə·lā·šeṯ hag·gə·mūl ’at·tem mə·šal·lə·mîm ‘ā·lāy wə·’im- gō·mə·lîm ’at·tem ‘ā·lay qal mə·hê·rāh ’ā·šîḇ gə·mul·ḵem bə·rō·šə·ḵem
verses.literal: Now what do you have against Me O Tyre Sidon and all the regions of Philistia Are you rendering against Me a recompense If you retaliate against Me I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads
verses.literalPt: Que tendes vós comigo, Tiro, e Sidom, e todas as regiões da Filístia? Acaso, me dareis vós a paga? E, se ma derdes, ligeira e prontamente vos farei tornar a paga sobre a vossa cabeça.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ כַּסְפִּ֥י וּזְהָבִ֖י לְקַחְתֶּ֑ם וּמַֽחֲמַדַּי֙ הַטֹּבִ֔ים הֲבֵאתֶ֖ם לְהֵיכְלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- kas·pî ū·zə·hā·ḇî lə·qaḥ·tem ū·ma·ḥă·mad·day haṭ·ṭō·ḇîm hă·ḇê·ṯem lə·hê·ḵə·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples
verses.literalPt: Porquanto levastes a minha prata e o meu ouro e metestes nos vossos templos as minhas coisas formosas e preciosas;

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מְכַרְתֶּ֖ם לִבְנֵ֣י הַיְּוָנִ֑ים לְמַ֥עַן הַרְחִיקָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇə·nê yə·rū·šā·lim mə·ḵar·tem liḇ·nê hay·yə·wā·nîm lə·ma·‘an har·ḥî·qām mê·‘al gə·ḇū·lām
verses.literal: You sold . . . the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks . . . to send them far from their homeland
verses.literalPt: também vendestes os filhos de Judá e os filhos de Jerusalém aos filhos dos gregos, para os removerdes longe dos seus confins,

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י מְעִירָ֔ם מִן־ הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י גְמֻלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mə·‘î·rām min- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- mə·ḵar·tem ’ō·ṯām šām·māh wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ḡə·mul·ḵem bə·rō·šə·ḵem
verses.literal: Behold I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them . . . I will return your recompense upon your heads
verses.literalPt: eis que os suscitarei do lugar para onde os vendestes e farei tornar a vossa paga sobre a vossa cabeça;

verses.original: וּמָכַרְתִּ֞י אֶת־ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וְאֶת־ בְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם בְּיַד֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמְכָר֥וּם לִשְׁבָאיִ֖ם אֶל־ גּ֣וֹי רָח֑וֹק כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·ḵar·tî ’eṯ- bə·nê·ḵem wə·’eṯ- bə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·yaḏ bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mə·ḵā·rūm liš·ḇā·yim ’el- gō·w rā·ḥō·wq kî Yah·weh dib·bêr
verses.literal: I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah and they will sell them to the Sabeans to a distant nation Indeed the LORD has spoken
verses.literalPt: venderei vossos filhos e vossas filhas nas mãos dos filhos de Judá, e eles os venderão aos homens de Sabá, a uma nação remota, pois Jeová o disse.

verses.original: קִרְאוּ־ זֹאת֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם קַדְּשׁ֖וּ מִלְחָמָ֑ה הָעִ֙ירוּ֙ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים יִגְּשׁ֣וּ יַֽעֲל֔וּ כֹּ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: qir·’ū- zōṯ bag·gō·w·yim qad·də·šū mil·ḥā·māh hā·‘î·rū hag·gib·bō·w·rîm yig·gə·šū ya·‘ă·lū kōl ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Proclaim this among the nations Prepare for war rouse the mighty men let all the men of war advance and attack
verses.literalPt: Proclamai isto entre as nações: Preparai a guerra; suscitai os valentes; cheguem-se todos os homens de guerra; subam.

verses.original: כֹּ֤תּוּ אִתֵּיכֶם֙ לַֽחֲרָב֔וֹת וּמַזְמְרֹֽתֵיכֶ֖ם לִרְמָחִ֑ים הַֽחַלָּ֔שׁ יֹאמַ֖ר גִּבּ֥וֹר אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kōt·tū ’it·tê·ḵem la·ḥă·rā·ḇō·wṯ ū·maz·mə·rō·ṯê·ḵem lir·mā·ḥîm ha·ḥal·lāš yō·mar gib·bō·wr ’ā·nî
verses.literal: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears Let the weak say I am strong
verses.literalPt: Forjai espadas das relhas dos vossos arados e lanças, das vossas podadeiras; diga o fraco: Eu sou forte.

verses.original: ע֣וּשׁוּ וָבֹ֧אוּ כָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם מִסָּבִ֖יב וְנִקְבָּ֑צוּ שָׁ֕מָּה הַֽנְחַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה גִּבּוֹרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·šū wā·ḇō·’ū ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·niq·bā·ṣū šām·māh han·ḥaṯ Yah·weh gib·bō·w·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Come quickly all you surrounding nations and gather yourselves Bring down Your mighty ones O LORD
verses.literalPt: Apressai-vos, e vinde, todas as nações ao redor, e ajuntai-vos; para ali faze, ó Jeová, descer os teus valentes.

verses.original: יֵע֙וֹרוּ֙ וְיַעֲל֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֶל־ עֵ֖מֶק יְהֽוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם אֵשֵׁ֛ב לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: yê·‘ō·w·rū wə·ya·‘ă·lū hag·gō·w·yim ’el- ‘ê·meq yə·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ kî šām ’ê·šêḇ liš·pōṭ ’eṯ- kāl- hag·gō·w·yim mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat for there I will sit down to judge all the nations on every side
verses.literalPt: Suscitem-se as nações e subam ao vale de Josafá; pois ali me sentarei para julgar todas as nações ao redor.

verses.original: שִׁלְח֣וּ מַגָּ֔ל כִּ֥י בָשַׁ֖ל קָצִ֑יר בֹּ֤אֽוּ רְדוּ֙ כִּֽי־ מָ֣לְאָה גַּ֔ת הֵשִׁ֙יקוּ֙ הַיְקָבִ֔ים כִּ֥י רַבָּ֖ה רָעָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šil·ḥū mag·gāl kî ḇā·šal qā·ṣîr bō·’ū rə·ḏū kî- mā·lə·’āh gaṯ hê·šî·qū hay·qā·ḇîm kî rab·bāh rā·‘ā·ṯām
verses.literal: Swing the sickle for the harvest is ripe Come trample the grapes for the winepress is full the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great
verses.literalPt: Metei a foice, porque está madura a ceifa; vinde, pisai, porque o lagar está cheio, e os vasos dos lagares trasbordam, pois grande é a sua malícia.

verses.original: הֲמוֹנִ֣ים הֲמוֹנִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶֽחָר֑וּץ כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶחָרֽוּץ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·mō·w·nîm hă·mō·w·nîm bə·‘ê·meq he·ḥā·rūṣ kî qā·rō·wḇ yō·wm Yah·weh bə·‘ê·meq he·ḥā·rūṣ
verses.literal: Multitudes multitudes in the valley of decision For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision
verses.literalPt: Multidões, multidões no vale da Decisão! Porque o Dia de Jeová está perto, no vale da Decisão.

verses.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֖חַ קָדָ֑רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נָגְהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: še·meš wə·yā·rê·aḥ qā·ḏā·rū wə·ḵō·w·ḵā·ḇîm ’ā·sə·p̄ū nā·ḡə·hām
verses.literal: The sun and moon will grow dark and the stars will no longer shine
verses.literalPt: O sol e a lua escurecem, e as estrelas retiram o seu resplendor.

verses.original: וַיהוָ֞ה מִצִּיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֗ג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔וֹ וְרָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיהוָה֙ מַֽחֲסֶ֣ה לְעַמּ֔וֹ וּמָע֖וֹז לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn yiš·’āḡ ū·mî·rū·šā·lim yit·tên qō·w·lōw wə·rā·‘ă·šū šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ Yah·weh ma·ḥă·seh lə·‘am·mōw ū·mā·‘ō·wz liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: The LORD will roar from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem heaven and earth will tremble But the LORD will be a refuge for His people a stronghold for the people of Israel
verses.literalPt: Jeová rugirá de Sião e de Jerusalém fará ouvir a sua voz; os céus e a terra tremerão; Jeová, porém, será um refúgio para o seu povo e um lugar forte para os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם שֹׁכֵ֖ן בְּצִיּ֣וֹן הַר־ קָדְשִׁ֑י וְהָיְתָ֤ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְזָרִ֥ים לֹא־ יַֽעַבְרוּ־ בָ֖הּ עֽוֹד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wî·ḏa‘·tem kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem šō·ḵên bə·ṣî·yō·wn har- qāḏ·šî wə·hā·yə·ṯāh yə·rū·šā·lim qō·ḏeš wə·zā·rîm lō- ya·‘aḇ·rū- ḇāh ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God who dwells in Zion My holy mountain Jerusalem will be holy never again to be overrun by foreigners
verses.literalPt: Assim sabereis que eu sou Jeová, vosso Deus, que habita em Sião, meu santo monte; então, Jerusalém será santa, e estrangeiros não passarão mais por ela.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִטְּפ֧וּ הֶהָרִ֣ים עָסִ֗יס וְהַגְּבָעוֹת֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה חָלָ֔ב וְכָל־ אֲפִיקֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יֵ֣לְכוּ מָ֑יִם וּמַעְיָ֗ן מִבֵּ֤ית יְהוָה֙ יֵצֵ֔א וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶת־ נַ֥חַל הַשִּׁטִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm ha·hū yiṭ·ṭə·p̄ū he·hā·rîm ‘ā·sîs wə·hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ tê·laḵ·nāh ḥā·lāḇ wə·ḵāl ’ă·p̄î·qê yə·hū·ḏāh yê·lə·ḵū mā·yim ū·ma‘·yān mib·bêṯ Yah·weh yê·ṣê wə·hiš·qāh ’eṯ- na·ḥal haš·šiṭ·ṭîm
verses.literal: And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine and the hills will flow with milk All the streams of Judah will run with water and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, acontecerá que os montes destilarão vinho doce, e os outeiros manarão leite, e em todas as torrentes de Judá correrão águas, e uma fonte sairá da Casa de Jeová e regará o vale de Sitim.

verses.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וֶאֱד֕וֹם לְמִדְבַּ֥ר שְׁמָמָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה מֵֽחֲמַס֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁפְכ֥וּ דָם־ נָקִ֖יא בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miṣ·ra·yim liš·mā·māh ṯih·yeh we·’ĕ·ḏō·wm lə·miḏ·bar šə·mā·māh tih·yeh mê·ḥă·mas bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer- šā·p̄ə·ḵū ḏām- nā·qî bə·’ar·ṣām
verses.literal: Egypt will become desolate and Edom a desert wasteland because of the violence done to the people of Judah in whose land they shed innocent blood
verses.literalPt: O Egito será uma desolação, e Edom, um deserto assolado, por causa da violência feita aos filhos de Judá, porque derramaram na sua terra o sangue inocente.

verses.original: וִיהוּדָ֖ה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְד֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hū·ḏāh lə·‘ō·w·lām tê·šêḇ wî·rū·šā·lim lə·ḏō·wr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: But Judah will be inhabited forever . . . and Jerusalem from generation to generation
verses.literalPt: Judá, porém, permanecerá para sempre, e Jerusalém, de geração em geração.

verses.original: וְנִקֵּ֖יתִי דָּמָ֣ם לֹֽא־ נִקֵּ֑יתִי וַֽיהוָ֖ה שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niq·qê·ṯî dā·mām lō- niq·qê·ṯî Yah·weh šō·ḵên bə·ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: For I will avenge their blood which I have not yet avenged For the LORD dwells in Zion
verses.literalPt: Eu purificarei o seu sangue que não purifiquei, pois Jeová habita em Sião.
